reviewStatus: FAVORABLE_LIMITED_STILL; engraving motif legibility UNRESOLVED; overall visual quality NOT_ACCEPTED_BY_THIS_REVIEW
basis: Provided completed held capture: epoch 5, fixture-4 cause, age 1100 ms, submit 16, six passes, generation/target 1. Receipt labels are preserved; no browser replay was performed by this reviewer.

findings.surrounding_space_glints: Several separate small warm crossed glints occupy the air above, below and between the five coins. Their sparse arrangement leaves clear negative space and keeps the gold silhouettes readable. This frame supports the displayed spatial treatment, not movement through that space.
findings.surface_glints: Coin faces remain comparatively clean; no large crossed optical ray visibly blankets a face in this still. Bright rim and relief responses cannot reliably be classified as separate authored face patches at this size. The source declares two face sites, but the still does not establish a visible count of two.
findings.engraving: Internal bright/darker relief marks and some straight-sided enclosure segments are visible. The complete closed six-sided groove and six-petal flower cannot be confidently recognized at original size; enlarged inspection preserves that uncertainty rather than adding missing detail.
findings.gold_and_shape: Warm pale-gold faces, brighter yellow rims and narrow darker sidewalls distinguish five separate minted coins. The slight oval projections and rim thickness read as coin volume. The soft face values leave enough internal variation for relief but do not establish correct conductor behavior through rotation.
findings.independent_timing: UNREVIEWED. R306 glints.mjs has per-coin cadence/phase and moving packet formulas; one held frame cannot prove their visible independent timing, drift, recurrence, disappearance or late intake density.

notAssessed: full lifetime and endpoint visual quality
scope: finite still only; not full quality acceptance; adoption unchanged unknown
